viewing_check: Estimate A$30-50, current bid A$20 (22% premium). Find and look through the second box, which does not appear in the photos. Open the jacketed Jeffrey Smart monograph: Beagle Press, Sydney 2005 or 2011 on the title page is the one to want (A$60-120 at auction); AGNSW 1999 or Wakefield Press is A$15-40. Check Ken Tyler and the Smart titles for signatures. Identify the 'Prints of the ...' and Celtic-cover titles. Reasonable up to about A$60 hammer (A$73 with premium); up to A$100 hammer if the Smart is Beagle Press or the second box holds more good monographs.
